opening.argument: The creator gives viewers a concrete path into paid participation in Forsage: send Ethereum, register under a specified upline, and use the participation link supplied in the description. The title presents a complete guide to joining and depositing Ethereum. The narration then identifies the upline, directs registration to a payment page, and expressly tells viewers to click the Forsage link. These instructions actively facilitate entry into a paid, upline-based structure. The material therefore supports a finding of scam recruitment through that structure, rather than mere discussion or investigation. That conclusion rests on the participation steps shown, without requiring claims about losses or promised returns.
